preconditions.description: The number of rows on the sheet of paper is at least 1 and at most 50.
The number of columns on the sheet of paper is at least 1 and at most 50.

preconditions.expression: All characters in the input are either '#' or '.'
preconditions.description: Each character in the input represents a square on the sheet of paper, either painted ('#') or not painted ('.').

preconditions.expression: The set of painted squares A is connected and not empty
preconditions.description: There is at least one painted square, and any two painted squares can be connected by a sequence of painted squares where each square, except for the last one, shares a common side with the square that follows next in the sequence.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if it is impossible to make the set A not connected, or a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of squares that need to be deleted to make the set A not connected.
